definitions.gloss: farewell gift; parting gift; going-away present (often money)
definitions.explanation: A gift, typically money in an envelope, given to someone who is moving away, transferring to another workplace, or embarking on a long journey.

examples.japanese: {餞別|せんべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{餞別|せんべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}った→贈る：09862_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I gave a farewell gift to a colleague being transferred.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皆|みな}さん→皆さん：02971_minasan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{餞別|せんべつ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただいた→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Before leaving to study abroad, I received cash as a farewell gift from everyone at work.

notes:
Written with the character {餞|せん} (farewell feast) + ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (parting). Traditionally, {餞別|せんべつ} often takes the form of money placed in a special envelope, though it can also be a physical gift.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {餞別|せんべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧ — to give a farewell gift
- {餞別|せんべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ — to receive a farewell gift (humble)
- {餞別|せんべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧ — to hand over a farewell gift
- {餞別|せんべつ}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ — farewell gift item

CULTURAL NOTE:
Giving {餞別|せんべつ} is a well-established Japanese custom, particularly in workplaces. When a colleague is transferred (⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧), retiring (⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧), or going on a long trip, coworkers typically collect money and present it in a ⟦{祝儀袋|しゅうぎぶくろ}→祝儀袋：20945_shuugibukuro⟧ (ceremonial envelope). The amount varies by relationship closeness, typically ranging from 3,000 to 10,000 yen.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- はなむけ — farewell words or gift (more literary; can refer to encouraging words as well as gifts)
- ⟦{送別|そうべつ}→送別：04391_soubetsu⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ — farewell gift (more general, less traditional nuance)
